llm.summary: The terminal state indicates clean liftoff under a clean process, although the matured result lagged the benchmark. The mixed causal label leaves unresolved whether the liftoff came from real-estate rotation, company alpha, or a catalyst, so no failure is established.
llm.root_cause: The terminal state indicates clean liftoff under a clean process, although the matured result lagged the benchmark. The mixed causal label leaves unresolved whether the liftoff came from real-estate rotation, company alpha, or a catalyst, so no failure is established.
llm.lesson: The watch and path-confirmation books surfaced a clean move, while benchmark-relative attribution remained incomplete.
llm.engines_credit: Path-confirmation organs are the provisional role models; rotation, sector, catalyst, and company-alpha attribution books lack enough recorded evidence for credit assignment.

causal_chain.mechanism: A shift toward real-estate exposure may have supported the observed liftoff.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Weak performance versus a real-estate benchmark would reduce the rotation explanation.

causal_chain.mechanism: Company-specific demand or repricing may have produced the clean upward path.
causal_chain.counterfactual: If peers showed the same path, company-specific alpha would be unnecessary.

causal_chain.mechanism: Benchmark strength may have exceeded the security's clean absolute move, producing negative relative performance without a defective process.
causal_chain.counterfactual: Against a sector or style-matched benchmark, the relative conclusion might differ.

alternate_explanations: A visible company catalyst drove the liftoff.
The move was merely sector beta.
The clean-liftoff label reflects path shape despite inadequate benchmark-relative magnitude.

signal_hypotheses.feature: Clean-liftoff persistence after sector and style adjustment
signal_hypotheses.measurement: Compare the observed path with matched real-estate peers and entry-time style exposures.
signal_hypotheses.expected_direction: Persistent residual liftoff would support company-specific attribution.
signal_hypotheses.falsifier: Matched peers exhibit the same path and remove the residual.
